# Vikash Malviya — Data Analyst Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Vikash Malviya, a Data Analyst based in Sojat, Rajasthan, India, specialising in SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel and Python for business intelligence and reporting.

## About

Vikash is a BCA graduate (Manipal University Jaipur, Data Analytics) who builds interactive Power BI dashboards, SQL-based analyses and Excel reports to identify trends, track KPIs and support data-driven business decisions. He has worked as an MIS Executive handling sales-order tracking, inventory reporting and Excel dashboards.
